name: air-purifier-coway
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. The manual prints an explicit table — 'Filter cleaning and replacement cycles': Pre-filter every 2~4 weeks (cleaning), Deodorization filter every 6 months (replacement), HEPA filter every 1 year (replacement). Cleaning chapter also covers the pollution sensor lens.
notes: The corpus's schedule-fidelity case. Three filters, three DIFFERENT manufacturer-stated intervals, printed in a table. Any of them arriving as as_needed is the 'never weaken a stated interval' rule being broken, and it is measurable here rather than arguable.

must_have.why: Stated as every 2~4 weeks. Cleaned, not replaced — so it also tests that the parser does not turn a washable part into a purchase.

should_have.why: The manual's own troubleshooting points at a dusty sensor lens; the prompt lists sensors explicitly.

must_not_have.why: Pressing the reset button is part of replacing a filter, not a separate chore to be reminded about.
